title: Websites
description: Responsive websites and landing pages with focus on design, UX and best development practices.
longDescription: A collection of websites and landing pages: Bikcraft, Casa Santé, Dogs (React social network), Licittare (Angular landing page), and Duck Shop (e-commerce with GSAP animations) — all focused on responsive, accessible design.

title: 42 Porto
description: Projects developed during the 42 Porto Common Core.
longDescription: Repository centralizing projects developed during 42 Porto's Common Core, covering C programming exercises, Shell Script, and logic challenges, with emphasis on low-level programming, memory management, and terminal automation.

title: Games
description: Interactive games and experiences — Pong with AI, detective puzzles, Canvas-based adventures and more.
longDescription: A collection of browser games and interactive experiences: Eri Pongson (Pong with AI), Secret Number Game, The Files (detective thriller), The Audition, and So_Long v3 (Canvas port of the 42 Porto project).

title: Sandlerflix
description: A project fully dedicated to Adam Sandler.
longDescription: Responsive frontend project dedicated exclusively to Adam Sandler's filmography, with adaptable layout for multiple devices, dynamic content organization, and focus on performance and usability.

title: BeanBase
description: BeanBase is a social network for coffee lovers: share your experiences, discover new cafes, and connect with the community.
longDescription: BeanBase is a full-stack social network for coffee lovers, built with React, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL. Features include Google OAuth authentication, Cloudinary image uploads, real-time search, a notifications system, and coffee shop management, deployed on Railway with Neon PostgreSQL.

title: Schedully
description: Multi-tenant SaaS scheduling platform with role-based auth, Stripe integration and Drizzle ORM.
longDescription: Schedully is a multi-tenant SaaS scheduling application built with React, Node.js, PostgreSQL and Stripe. Features authentication with roles, multi-tenant data architecture, relational schema with Drizzle ORM, protected routes, global state with Zustand, and form validation with React Hook Form + Zod.

title: Strata
description: Interactive 3D web application for designing and simulating industrial drilling patterns and blast sequences.
longDescription: Strata is an interactive 3D visualization tool built with React and Three.js, allowing engineers and designers to plan, visualize, and simulate industrial drilling patterns and blast sequences in real time. Features a Node.js backend for data processing.

title: Spotify Clone
description: Spotify interface clone using CSS and JS effects.
longDescription: Functional clone of Spotify interface, developed for educational purposes, with responsive layout, simulated music player, dynamic interactions via JavaScript, and advanced CSS styling. Subsequently optimized with React, Vite, and TailwindCSS.

title: Base Projects
description: Foundational projects covering JS, React, Node.js and full-stack development fundamentals.
longDescription: A set of projects that consolidate core development skills: Green Loop (hackathon), Notes App, Party Time (full-stack), Budget App, Fokus (Pomodoro), and Encryptor — each exploring different layers of web development.
